verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents an Agent Server that exposes the agent behind an HTTP and WebSocket API. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at docs.openhands.dev/openapi.json, and the pricing page advertises "API support for automation and scripting." Together these show a first-party, documented public API for driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of endpoint coverage and authentication for the Cloud API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Agent Server package (`openhands-agent-server`) runs the OpenHands Software Agent SDK behind an HTTP and WebSocket API.
